claims.claim: For independent edge states, two-terminal reliability is affine in each edge survival probability and its partial derivative equals that edge's pivotal probability.
The pivotal derivative is independent of the target edge's own survival probability.
Under an infinitesimal linear budget, the maximum first-order gain equals B times the maximum pivotality-to-cost ratio.
Two required series edges have positive mixed interaction while two parallel edges have negative mixed interaction.
In the specified triangle, equal-conductance current and independent-failure pivotality produce opposite priority rankings.
Marginal edge survival probabilities do not identify terminal reliability when failures are correlated.
The adversarial gate passed 13 aggregate checks with no preregistered failure triggered.
Current-flow and edge-removal corridor models are established ecological-priority methods, and independent validation can change corridor recommendations.
Static and single-dimension connectivity priorities can miss changing long-horizon exposure.
The independent Bernoulli edge model accurately represents a real corridor network.
A $7,500 audit will create customer value.
The HDFM specialization is novel or scientifically significant beyond established Birnbaum importance and corridor-priority literature.
claims.support: Independent significance and prior-art review required
